verses.html: A Song or Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.text: A Song or Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.title: A Song or Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: A Song or Psalm of David.

verses.html: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.text: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.html: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.text: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

verses.html: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.text: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.html: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

verses.html: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.text: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.html: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.html: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.text: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.html: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.text: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

verses.html: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.html: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.text: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

verses.html: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.text: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.html: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.text: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
